regime_read: The pack shows two distinct cohesion pockets: a memory/semis cluster (MU, AMAT, INTC, NVDA) around patent and congressional accumulation, and a Washington-linked defense/gov-contract cluster (PLTR, MRK, NVDA) around contract acceleration and disclosed stakes. No track record exists yet, so every read here is a hypothesis, not a measured edge.
regime_read_zh: 该数据包呈现两个明显合力区：存储/半导体集群（MU、AMAT、INTC、NVDA）围绕专利和国会持仓积累，以及华盛顿关联的防务/政府合同集群（PLTR、MRK、NVDA）围绕合同加速与披露持仓。目前没有任何历史战绩，因此此处所有判断均为假设，而非已验证的优势。

theses.thesis: MU is the highest-convergence name in the pack (convergence 5, weighted 2.4) with five independent channels aligning: [congress_cluster] shows a net-6 congressional stance with 3 members, [insider_mspr] reads 100 (strongest possible insider signal), [patent_cluster] at 369 patents, [affiliation] via Rep. Ro Khanna, and [stocktwits_bull] at 1.0 with 213k watchers. RS vs SPY is only +5.7 over 60d, so it is NOT extended and the entry remains viable. However, the desk's own calibration note states zero scored theses, so a WATCH is the honest action while the convergence matures.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 是该数据包中合力最强的标的（合力分 5，权重 2.4），五个独立信号源一致：[congress_cluster] 显示国会净持仓 +6、涉及 3 名议员，[insider_mspr] 读数为 100（最强内部人信号），[patent_cluster] 达 369 项专利，[affiliation] 通过众议员 Ro Khanna 建立，[stocktwits_bull] 看多比 1.0、21.3 万关注者。60 日相对 SPY 表现仅 +5.7，未过度延伸，建仓窗口仍然可行。但本台自报战绩为零，在此合力成熟前，WATCH 是诚实的选择。
second_order: AMAT (memory-fab equipment; same patent/congress alignment, RS -15.3 offers fresh entry)
INTC (US-CHIPS memory/logic capacity; gov-grant + patent channel, RS -17.8)
NVDA (HBM demand into AI accelerators; memory capacity expansion directly benefits)
theses.dissent: Insider MSPR of 100 could be a single cluster of filings rather than broad accumulation, and a 100 read has no variance to distinguish signal from noise; the affiliation link is qualitative only.

falsifier.text: A fresh SEC Form 4 filing shows net selling from MU insiders over the next 30 days, breaking the insider_mspr alignment.

theses.thesis: LUV shows four independent channels converging on an activist-driven catalyst: [activist_13d] confirms a disclosed activist stake, [affiliation] links Paul Singer (Elliott) who is a known operational-improvement activist, [app_demand] shows exceptional demand with a 4.84 rating and 7.2M reviews, and [material_8k] counts 3 filings in 30d suggesting rapid developments. Critically, RS vs SPY is -10.2, meaning the name has UNDERPERFORMED and the activist entry thesis is not yet priced in — a genuine ACCUMULATE window. This is the single cleanest activist value setup in today's pack.
theses.thesis_zh: LUV 具备四个独立信号源汇聚在激进投资者驱动的催化剂上：[activist_13d] 确认已披露激进股东持仓，[affiliation] 关联 Paul Singer（Elliott），其为知名的运营改进型激进投资者，[app_demand] 显示需求极强——评分 4.84、评论达 720 万条，[material_8k] 30 天内 3 份重大文件表明事态快速发展。关键的是，RS vs SPY 为 -10.2，表明该股跑输大盘、激进投资者入场的主题尚未被定价——这是真正的建仓窗口。这是今日数据包中最干净的单笔激进价值布局。
second_order: IEP (Icahn Enterprises, Eikon value-activist holding company — label_mismatch repointed to activist_value theme)
CVI (CVR Energy, Icahn-controlled energy name repointed to activist_value theme)
航空业供应商 (airline cost-structure reforms under activist pressure typically flow to MRO and parts suppliers)
theses.dissent: A 13D can be a hedge or negotiating posture rather than a genuine operational thesis, and Singer's airline activism has a mixed track record; app demand may reflect consumer travel rebound that is already partially reflected in other airlines.

falsifier.text: A subsequent 13D/A reveals the activist stake has been reduced below 5% before any operational changes are announced.

theses.thesis: MRK has four converging healthcare-catalyst signals: [clinical_phase3_start] with 11 Phase 3 starts, [fda_label_expansion] indicating regulatory tailwinds, [special_situation] flagging a structural catalyst, and [trump] with a 'buy' side reading from disclosed Trump-linked flows. The bill_catalysts for HR10087 (Cancer Care Planning Act) directly aligns with MRK's oncology franchise. RS vs SPY is +20.7 over 60d — NOT extended but already showing strong momentum, so the move has begun. A WATCH is appropriate to measure whether the clinical pipeline momentum sustains before adding.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK 具有四个汇聚的医疗催化剂信号：[clinical_phase3_start] 11 项 III 期临床启动，[fda_label_expansion] 显示监管顺风，[special_situation] 标记结构性催化剂，[trump] 在披露的关联资金流中呈买入方向。法案催化剂 HR10087（癌症护理规划法案）与 MRK 的肿瘤管线直接契合。60 日 RS vs SPY 为 +20.7——尚未过度延伸，但已显示强劲动能，行情已经启动。在加仓之前，WATCH 以衡量临床管线动能是否持续是恰当的。
second_order: ABBV (same clinical_phase3_start + fda_label_expansion channels, 9 Phase 3 starts, 2 halts)
肿瘤诊断与护理协调服务商 (Cancer Care Planning Act beneficiaries: care coordination platforms)
肿瘤放射与手术设备商 (Ion beam / LINAC makers benefiting from increased oncology treatment volumes)
theses.dissent: Three clinical halts alongside the 11 starts suggest pipeline attrition risk, and the Trump 'buy' side reading may be a short-term flow artifact rather than fundamental conviction.

falsifier.text: A subsequent FDA Complete Response Letter for any MRK Phase 3 oncology candidate, or an increase in clinical_halts above 3 in the next quarter.

track_record.calibration_note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

track_record.note: Alt-data brain theses graded vs SPY. The actionable axis is calibrated by this track record; conviction defers to it.
